passages.text: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless.
passages.sermon:
Abram was ninety-nine years old.
The LORD appeared to Abram.
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD said, “I am God Almighty.
Walk before Me.
Be blameless.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י אַבְרָ֔ם בֶּן־ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְתֵ֣שַׁע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיֵּרָ֨א יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ אַבְרָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֲנִי־ אֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֔י הִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לְפָנַ֖י וֶהְיֵ֥ה תָמִֽים׃

passages.text: I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God said, “I will make a covenant with you.
This covenant is between Me and you.
I will greatly increase your numbers.
You will become very many.”
passages.original: וְאֶתְּנָ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖י בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאַרְבֶּ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ בִּמְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Then Abram fell facedown, and God said to him, “As for Me, this is My covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
passages.sermon:
Abram was ninety-nine years old.
The LORD appeared to Abram.
The LORD is God Almighty.
Abram fell facedown.
God spoke to Abram.
God said, “This is My covenant with you.
You will be the father of many nations.”
passages.original: וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַבְרָ֖ם עַל־ פָּנָ֑יו וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֲנִ֕י הִנֵּ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וְהָיִ֕יתָ לְאַ֖ב הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: No longer will you be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God made a covenant with Abram.
God changed Abram’s name.
God said, “You will not be called Abram anymore.”
God said, “Your name will be Abraham.”
God said, “I have made you a father of many nations.”
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד אֶת־ שִׁמְךָ֖ אַבְרָ֑ם וְהָיָ֤ה שִׁמְךָ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֛י אַב־ הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God promised Abraham many blessings.
God said, “I will make you very fruitful.
You will have many descendants.
I will make nations come from you.
Kings will come from your descendants.”
passages.original: וְהִפְרֵתִ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְגוֹיִ֑ם וּמְלָכִ֖ים מִמְּךָ֥ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃

passages.text: I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God made a promise to Abraham.
God called this promise a covenant.
God said this covenant would last forever.
God made this covenant between Himself and Abraham.
God also made this covenant with Abraham’s descendants.
God said He would be Abraham’s God.
God said He would be the God of Abraham’s descendants.
passages.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֜י בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֗ךָ וּבֵ֨ין זַרְעֲךָ֧ אַחֲרֶ֛יךָ לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם לִבְרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֑ם לִהְי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And to you and your descendants I will give the land where you are residing—all the land of Canaan—as an eternal possession; and I will be their God.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God promised Abraham a gift.
God said, “I will give you land.
I will give this land to your descendants after you.
This is the land where you are living now.
This land is all the land of Canaan.
I will give this land to you and your descendants forever.
I will be God to your descendants.”
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְ֠ךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֨ אַחֲרֶ֜יךָ אֵ֣ת׀ אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֗יךָ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לַאֲחֻזַּ֖ת עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: God also said to Abraham, “You must keep My covenant—you and your descendants in the generations after you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God had chosen Abraham.
God had made a covenant with Abraham.
God said, “You must keep My covenant.
Your descendants must also keep My covenant.
Every generation after you must keep it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֔ם וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֑ר אַתָּ֛ה וְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַֽחֲרֶ֖יךָ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: This is My covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you are to keep: Every male among you must be circumcised.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God made a covenant with Abraham.
God included Abraham’s descendants in this covenant.
God told Abraham to keep this covenant.
God told Abraham’s descendants to keep this covenant after him.
God said, “This is My covenant between Me and you.
This is also My covenant with your descendants after you.
Every male among you must be circumcised.”
passages.original: זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֞י אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֗וּ בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֥ין זַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ הִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֖ם כָּל־ זָכָֽר׃

passages.text: You are to circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and this will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God commanded Abraham and his descendants to keep His covenant.
God said, “You must circumcise the flesh of your foreskin.
This act will be a sign.
The sign will show the covenant between Me and you.”
passages.original: וּנְמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלַתְכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ לְא֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old, including those born in your household and those purchased from a foreigner—even those who are not your offspring.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God gave Abraham a command for all his descendants.
God said, “Every male among you must be circumcised.”
You must circumcise each male when he is eight days old.
This rule applies to every generation.
You must circumcise boys born in your household.
You must also circumcise boys you purchase from a foreigner.
This includes boys who are not your own offspring.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ שְׁמֹנַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֛ם כָּל־ זָכָ֖ר לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּמִקְנַת־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מִכֹּ֣ל בֶּן־ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֖ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Whether they are born in your household or purchased, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh will be an everlasting covenant.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God gave Abraham a command.
Every male in your household must be circumcised.
This includes those born in your house.
This also includes those you have purchased.
You must circumcise all of them.
My covenant will be in your flesh.
This covenant will last forever.
passages.original: הִמּ֧וֹל׀ יִמּ֛וֹל יְלִ֥יד בֵּֽיתְךָ֖ וּמִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפֶּ֑ךָ וְהָיְתָ֧ה בְרִיתִ֛י בִּבְשַׂרְכֶ֖ם לִבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: But if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God gave Abraham a covenant.
God required every male to be circumcised.
A male who is not circumcised has not obeyed God’s command.
That male has not removed the flesh of his foreskin.
That male will be separated from his people.
He has broken God’s covenant.
passages.original: וְעָרֵ֣ל׀ זָכָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִמּוֹל֙ אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלָת֔וֹ וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּ֑יהָ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י הֵפַֽר׃ס

passages.text: Then God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, do not call her Sarai, for her name is to be Sarah.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God said, “Your wife is Sarai.
Do not call her Sarai anymore.
Her name will be Sarah.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֔ם שָׂרַ֣י אִשְׁתְּךָ֔ לֹא־ תִקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמָ֖הּ שָׂרָ֑י כִּ֥י שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will descend from her.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God spoke about Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
God said, “I will bless Sarah.”
God said, “I will give you a son by Sarah.”
God said, “I will bless Sarah again.”
God said, “Sarah will become the mother of nations.”
God said, “Kings of peoples will come from Sarah.”
passages.original: וּבֵרַכְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔הּ וְגַ֨ם נָתַ֧תִּי מִמֶּ֛נָּה לְךָ֖ בֵּ֑ן וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יהָ֙ וְהָֽיְתָ֣ה לְגוֹיִ֔ם מַלְכֵ֥י עַמִּ֖ים מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed and said to himself, “Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?”
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a man chosen by God.
God spoke to Abraham.
Abraham heard God's promise.
Abraham fell facedown.
Abraham laughed.
Abraham spoke in his heart.
Abraham asked himself a question.
He said, "Can a child be born to a man who is one hundred years old?"
He said, "Can Sarah give birth at ninety years old?"
passages.original: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל אַבְרָהָ֛ם עַל־ פָּנָ֖יו וַיִּצְחָ֑ק וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בְּלִבּ֗וֹ הַלְּבֶ֤ן מֵאָֽה־ שָׁנָה֙ יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְאִ֨ם־ שָׂרָ֔ה הֲבַת־ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תֵּלֵֽד׃

passages.text: And Abraham said to God, “O that Ishmael might live under Your blessing!”
passages.sermon:
Abraham spoke to God.
Abraham said, “Let Ishmael live before You.”
Abraham wanted Ishmael to receive God’s blessing.
Ishmael was Abraham’s son.
Abraham hoped God would care for Ishmael.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶל־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים ל֥וּ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל יִחְיֶ֥ה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: But God replied, “Your wife Sarah will indeed bear you a son, and you are to name him Isaac. I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God said, “Sarah is your wife.
Sarah will give birth to a son for you.
You will name your son Isaac.
I will make a covenant with Isaac.
This covenant will last forever.
This covenant will be for Isaac’s descendants after him.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲבָל֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֗ יֹלֶ֤דֶת לְךָ֙ בֵּ֔ן וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ יִצְחָ֑ק וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֥י אִתּ֛וֹ לִבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם לְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃

passages.text: As for Ishmael, I have heard you, and I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He will become the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God said, “I have heard you about Ishmael.
I will bless Ishmael.
I will make Ishmael fruitful.
I will greatly multiply Ishmael.
Ishmael will become the father of twelve rulers.
I will make Ishmael into a great nation.”
passages.original: וּֽלְיִשְׁמָעֵ֘אל שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ֒ הִנֵּ֣ה׀ בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹת֗וֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֤ר נְשִׂיאִם֙ יוֹלִ֔יד וּנְתַתִּ֖יו לְג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time next year.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abraham.
God promised to make a covenant.
God said this covenant would be with Isaac.
Sarah, Abraham’s wife, would give birth to Isaac.
Sarah would have Isaac at this same time next year.
God would establish His covenant with Isaac.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אָקִ֣ים אֶת־ יִצְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁר֩ תֵּלֵ֨ד לְךָ֤ שָׂרָה֙ לַמּוֹעֵ֣ד הַזֶּ֔ה בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הָאַחֶֽרֶת׃

passages.text: When He had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
passages.sermon: God spoke with Abraham.\r\nGod finished speaking.\r\nGod went up from Abraham.
passages.original: וַיְכַ֖ל לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֣עַל אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵעַ֖ל אַבְרָהָֽם׃

passages.text: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or purchased with his money—every male among the members of Abraham’s household—and he circumcised them, just as God had told him.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was the father of Ishmael.
Abraham had a household with many people.
Some people in Abraham’s household were born there.
Some people in Abraham’s household were purchased with his money.
All the males in Abraham’s household belonged to him.
God spoke to Abraham and gave him a command.
On that very day, Abraham obeyed God.
Abraham took his son Ishmael.
Abraham took all the males born in his household.
Abraham took all the males he had purchased with his money.
Abraham circumcised every male in his household.
Abraham did this just as God had told him.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֗וֹ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ יְלִידֵ֤י בֵיתוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ מִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפּ֔וֹ כָּל־ זָכָ֕ר בְּאַנְשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיָּ֜מָל אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלָתָ֗ם בְּעֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: So Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised, and his son Ishmael was thirteen; Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised on the same day.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was ninety-nine years old.
Abraham was circumcised at that age.
Ishmael was Abraham’s son.
Ishmael was thirteen years old.
Ishmael was circumcised at that age.
Abraham and Ishmael were circumcised on the same day.
passages.original: וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם בֶּן־ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וָתֵ֖שַׁע שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִמֹּל֖וֹ בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֔וֹ בֶּן־ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִ֨מֹּל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃ בְּעֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה נִמּ֖וֹל אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And all the men of Abraham’s household—both servants born in his household and those purchased from foreigners—were circumcised with him.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was the head of his household.
His household included many men.
Some men were born in Abraham’s house.
Other men were purchased from foreigners.
Abraham circumcised all these men.
They were circumcised together with Abraham.
passages.original: וְכָל־ אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵיתוֹ֙ יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּמִקְנַת־ כֶּ֖סֶף מֵאֵ֣ת בֶּן־ נֵכָ֑ר נִמֹּ֖לוּ אִתּֽוֹ׃פ
